Scale: the plate is square-ish and spans about 450 px, so I'm treating it as a dinner plate of about 26 cm, roughly 17 px per cm.

The pizza slice is a rectangle of about 130 px by 200 px, which is roughly 8 cm by 12 cm, or about 90 cm² (some of it is cut off at the edge of the frame). A thin cheese pizza at about 1 cm thick gives roughly 90 cm³. With a bready, airy crust at a density of about 0.5 g/cm³, that comes to around 50 g. A sheet-pan or Sicilian-style slice of this size would likely weigh about 80 g, so I'm going with 80 g.
